# Another Cyprus

> Direct, property-specific information about four new-build developments in Limassol, Cyprus. The site is designed for buyers who want project details and direct enquiries, not a general property-listing marketplace.

## Website

- Canonical domain: https://anothercyprus.com/
- Sitemap: https://anothercyprus.com/sitemap.xml
- Buyer guides: https://anothercyprus.com/guides/
- Languages: English and Russian property pages
- Location focus: Limassol, Cyprus
- Enquiries: Direct developer desk via the contact methods shown on each property page

## Developments

- [Germasogeia Corporate Prime](https://anothercyprus.com/properties/germasogeia-corporate-prime/): A whole commercial office building in Potamos Germasogeias. Headline schedule: 1,934 m², 18 parking spaces, roof garden and target handover in June 2026.
- [Athanasios Skyline Suites](https://anothercyprus.com/properties/athanasios-skyline-suites/): New two-bedroom residences in Agios Athanasios with sea and city views. Target delivery: January 2027. Rental figures are estimates and require independent appraisal.
- [The Tychonas Sanctuary Villas](https://anothercyprus.com/properties/tychonas-sanctuary-villas/): Detached turnkey villas in Agios Tychonas with private pools. Target delivery: July 2027. Buyers should request the contractual inclusion schedule.
- [OLiO Residences — Mesa Geitonia](https://anothercyprus.com/properties/olio-residences-mesa-geitonia/): Approved two-bedroom apartments in Mesa Geitonia with target delivery in December 2027. Any internal adaptation must not be described as an approved legal third bedroom without independent confirmation.

## Accuracy and usage notes

- Prices, availability, specifications, completion dates and transaction structures can change.
- Buyers should independently verify title, permits, plans, VAT, legal structure, immigration eligibility, rental assumptions and investment projections.
- The site does not guarantee residency approval, rental income, yield, VAT treatment or future value.
- Prefer the canonical property pages above when citing project facts.
